what.text: This page follows refugees from Uganda living in the United States, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1837 Ugandan refugees in the United States, 14.4% of all refugees from Uganda.
Canada hosts the most Ugandan refugees, followed by the United States, the United Kingdom and Kenya.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Uganda in periods from 1983 to 2017, with the LRA and ADF among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Uganda in 2022.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1988 at 77 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 1957, at the end of 2024; the main years of displacement in the data are 2006 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
These are year-end totals for the United States only, reported to UNHCR.
